title: Trump-Linked Crypto Firm Wins OCC Trust Bank Charter
description_short: Trump-Linked Crypto Firm Wins OCC Trust Bank Charter
description_medium: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency conditionally approved a national trust bank charter for World Liberty Financial, the crypto venture co-founded by President Donald Trump and associated with Eric Trump. If it receives final approvals, the company plans to manage its USD1 stablecoin, moving the Trump-linked firm further into federally supervised finance.
description_long: In August 2026, the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency conditionally approved a national trust bank charter for World Liberty Financial, a crypto venture co-founded by President Donald Trump and associated with his son Eric Trump. The proposed bank, World Liberty Trust Company, would issue or support the company’s USD1 stablecoin. American Banker reported that the conditional approval allows the firm to proceed with preparations, while final approvals remain necessary before the planned operation can begin. The article said World Liberty intends to take over management of USD1 from BitGo Bank and Trust if those approvals are secured. The charter decision came amid debate over whether digital-asset firms should receive access to federal banking structures and what safeguards should apply to stablecoin issuers. Critics cited the president’s connection to the venture and warned about conflicts of interest; approval itself does not establish misconduct. The OCC action is a regulatory step with potential implications for oversight and competition in stablecoin services. The linked report describes the approval as conditional, so it should not be confused with a fully operational bank or completed transfer of stablecoin management.
